host: Windows x64, QEMU 11.1.0 (TCG), qemu ADT profile, --smp 2
source: read from physical memory with QEMU's pmemsave, then decoded with the arm64 boot_args layout of pexpert/pexpert/arm64/boot.h at xnu-8796.141.3
cross_checks: physBase 0x48004000 and virtBase 0xFFFFFFF007004000 match the DARWINBOOT line in the serial log
video 0x6c7a0000 / 800x600 / row 3200 / 32 bpp matches both that line and the kernel's own initialize_screen record
deviceTreeLength 0x2c58 is exactly 11352 bytes, the size of the staged kernel.macho.adt that make-lumia950-adt.py produced
commandLine '-v keepsyms=1 debug=0x100 cpus=1' matches the xnu entry's args in the staged unixnu.toml
memSize 0x20000000 is the ownership bound the bring-up profile asks for, not the full 0xaf600000 DRAM: DarwinBoot clamped the map as designed
defect_found_and_fixed: The decoder first read CommandLine at 0x70 and produced 'eepsyms=1 ...': the field starts at 0x6c, right after deviceTreeLength, and reading four bytes late silently drops '-v '. The test suite pins 0x6c now.
not_proven: that a handset hands over the same structure (nothing has run on one)
that XNU uses the command line it was given
